evidence_roots.name: pre_fallback_epoch_adoption_128mib
evidence_roots.conclusion: 128MiB proved the full live route epoch chain but exposed fallback V6 terminal starvation from stale transport epoch proof.

evidence_roots.name: post_fallback_epoch_adoption_128mib
evidence_roots.conclusion: Rerun failed earlier in regular V4 runtime unlock because activation offer send was not observed and liveness terminalized before Tuna activation.

decision: Keep 128MiB as the canonical repeated-toggle stress payload. It provides enough runtime to prove live epochs and expose fallback/runtime-unlock coordination failures that shorter 64MiB runs can miss.
non_goals: No bridge queue or concurrency tuning
No Tuna wallet or payer policy changes
